# Vendored `@fnm/core`

A snapshot of the Finnomena Pattern Builder core (`block/packages/core/src`), copied in so Mixture runs on its own. Mixture uses it to generate Bricks.

- Source: `finnomena/block` at `48be2602af1398718fe0071262818486b4d6f563`
- Do not edit these files. To update, run `npm run vendor:sync -- [ref]` (default `origin/main`), which copies `packages/core/src/**/*.ts` (not the tests) over them and updates the hash above.
